kjv: And Philip said, If thou (the eunuch) believest with all thine heart, thou mayest. And he (the eunuch) answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God.
note: Absent from P45, P74, Sinaiticus, A, B, C and most minuscules; a baptismal confession added (Western text) to answer the eunuch's question. Erasmus printed it from a margin and the Latin.
